title: Milwaukee Paddle Tavern | The Harp
specs: Pub crawl with stops at 2-4 bars in Milwaukee's Third Ward and Walker's Point
21+ for public tours due to alcohol
To pedal bike, need to be about 5'3" or taller; shorter guests can sit or bartend
Children 12 or younger must wear life vest on boats
Bikes seat up to 16 people; boats seat 14-26 depending on type; can book multiple bikes or boats for groups up to 96
includes: Sound system on each bike and boat
Coolers for drinks on bikes and boats
Licensed driver for bikes and licensed captain and first mate for boats
blurb: Guests pedal a multi-seat bike or boat through Milwaukee's historic districts or along the Milwaukee River, stopping at bars. Bikes seat up to 16 people; boats seat up to 16 or more depending on type. Tours include music, coolers for drinks, and a licensed driver or captain.
extraNote: Cancel 14+ days prior for refund on bike tours; 5-13 days get rain check; within 4 days no refund · Cancel 30 days prior for full refund on boat tours; 15-29 days get credit; less than 15 days no refund · Tours run rain or shine except for nasty weather; ponchos and roofs provided · Cooperage Building 820 S. Water St. for pedal tavern bikes; docks behind the Harp, 113 E Juneau Ave for Paddle Tavern boats; Duffy Rentals launch from Cooperage Building. · Mid-March through the end of October
